newsitem.title: USA: Covenant, J.B. Hunt in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Covenant, J.B. Hunt in alliance.

text.p: Covenant Transport Inc and J.B. Hunt Transport Services Inc, two transportation companies, said Tuesday they have a strategic alliance to jointly market and provide transcontinental full-load transportation services in an exclusive arrangement.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The companies said in a statement the alliance brings them together to deliver "just-in-time, express delivery that requires team drivers, and intermodal service that has evolved into a reliable lower cost alternative to single driver truck transit."
